change: Added a bounded sequential batch wrapper around the already validated single-run executor.
safety_properties: claims only the next run from the frozen campaign state
refuses to start when another attempt is active
requires the campaign to be paused at batch start
checks that each run increments the valid-run count
stops immediately on an invalid or failed run
does not start a run that exceeds the remaining wall-time budget
writes a timestamped batch log and JSON summary
